title: Coddy
description: Agents, relays and their model calls from the Prometheus exporter of coddy serve (metrics.enable). Every node of a swarm is a target of its own.

list.name: by
list.label: Group by
list.description: The label the per-group panels split by: instance, job, or any label your scrape config puts on the targets (node, role, site).

panels.title: Up
panels.description: coddy serve processes whose exporter answered the last scrape: the agents and the relays of a swarm alike.

panels.title: Down
panels.description: Targets of the selected jobs that did not answer the last scrape. CoddyDown fires after 5 minutes.

panels.title: Busy
panels.description: Sessions with a turn running right now, summed over the selected processes.

panels.title: Turns
panels.description: Turns started per minute on every surface (web UI, API, messengers, background wakes).

panels.title: Calls
panels.description: Provider invocation attempts per minute, retries included.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Share of attempts that ended in anything but ok or canceled. CoddyProviderFailing watches 20% per provider.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input plus output tokens the providers reported, per minute.

panels.title: Oldest
panels.description: Age of the longest-running turn. A wait for a permission or a usage limit is legitimate, so a high value is a hint, not proof of a hang.

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: One row per scraped coddy serve process: agents and relays of a swarm each run their own exporter. Turns, Waiting (prompts for a person) and Tasks are now, Model calls is over the time range, Disk free is the disk of the session store, Restart is coddy_restart_required.

panels.title: Turns started / min
panels.description: Turns started per minute, grouped by the label chosen in Group by.

panels.title: Turns running
panels.description: Sessions with a turn running, stacked per group.

panels.title: Turn duration
panels.description: Quantiles of the turns that ended, from the moment the session became busy to the end of the turn.

panels.title: Oldest running turn
panels.description: Age of the longest-running turn of each group; the dashed line is the CoddyTurnLongRunning threshold (1 hour).

panels.title: Tool calls / min by tool
panels.description: Calls of each built-in tool per minute; mcp is any tool of an MCP server, other a name the agent does not know.

panels.title: Tool calls / min by outcome
panels.description: ok and error ran; refused never ran (mode, toolset, hook, safety check); denied was declined at the permission prompt.

panels.title: Tool calls / min by $by
panels.description: Which processes of the fleet call tools.

panels.title: Tool error ratio by tool
panels.description: Calls that ran and returned an error, over the calls that ran.

targets.expr: sum by (tool) (rate(coddy_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (tool) (rate(coddy_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome=~"ok|error"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tool duration p95 by tool
panels.description: How long the tools ran, hooks excluded (buckets 0.1 s to 300 s).

panels.title: Prompts waiting by kind
panels.description: Permission prompts and questions that wait for a person to answer; a turn that waits shows here, not as a hang.

panels.title: Prompts waiting by $by
panels.description: Which processes of the fleet wait for a person.

panels.title: Provider quota used
panels.description: Share of each usage window of the provider accounts, from the cache of the session manager (providers with a usage reader: neuraldeep, codex, devin). The dashed line is the 90% of CoddyProviderQuotaHigh.

panels.title: Relay nodes by state
panels.description: Nodes the relays of the selected processes know, by kind (agent, relay), transport (direct, tunnel) and state; only the combinations that hold a node. A gap is a relay that did not answer the scrape.

panels.title: Online registrations by $by
panels.description: Registrations of the selected processes into their parent relays whose last attempt succeeded.

panels.title: Offline registrations by relay
panels.description: A process that cannot register into its relay is missing from the swarm; CoddySwarmJoinDown fires after 5 minutes.

panels.title: Attempts / min by outcome
panels.description: Every provider invocation attempt lands in exactly one outcome; a retried call counts once per try.

panels.title: Attempts / min by provider and model
panels.description: model="other" collects models the configuration does not declare.

panels.title: Failure ratio by provider
panels.description: Attempts that ended in anything but ok or canceled, per provider. The dashed line is the 20% of CoddyProviderFailing.

targets.expr: sum by (provider) (rate(coddy_llm_attempts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", outcome!~"ok|canceled"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (provider) (rate(coddy_llm_attempts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Attempt duration by provider
panels.description: Quantiles of the whole attempt, the full stream included (buckets 0.5 s to 600 s).

panels.title: Attempts / min by $by
panels.description: Which processes of the fleet call the providers.

panels.title: Failed attempts / min by $by
panels.description: Failed attempts per group, to tell a provider outage from one misconfigured node.

panels.title: Time to first token by provider
panels.description: From the start of a streamed attempt to its first chunk with text, reasoning or a tool call (buckets 0.25 s to 60 s).

panels.title: Retries / min by provider
panels.description: Attempts the retry wrapper made after a failed one of the same call.

panels.title: Tokens / min
panels.description: Tokens the providers reported per minute. Cached input is a subset of the input tokens.

panels.title: Tokens / min by model
panels.description: Input plus output tokens per declared model.

targets.expr: (sum by (provider, model) (rate(coddy_llm_input_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (provider, model) (rate(coddy_llm_output_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider"}[$__rate_interval]))) * 60

panels.title: Prompt cache hit ratio by provider
panels.description: Cached input tokens over all input tokens: how much of each prompt the provider served from its cache.

targets.expr: (sum by (provider) (rate(coddy_llm_cached_input_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (provider) (rate(coddy_llm_input_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (provider) (rate(coddy_llm_input_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tokens / min by $by
panels.description: Input plus output tokens per group of processes.

panels.title: Output tokens / attempt by provider
panels.description: Average answer length per successful attempt.

targets.expr: sum by (provider) (rate(coddy_llm_output_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (provider) (rate(coddy_llm_attempts_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", outcome="ok"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Background tasks by kind
panels.description: Shell commands, subagents and preview servers the model started that are queued or running.

panels.title: Configuration reloads
panels.description: Replacements of the live configuration: a save from Settings, an edit of config.yaml, a config tool call.

panels.title: Subsystems
panels.description: 1 for a subsystem the process runs or is starting, 0 for one the configuration enables and the process does not run.

panels.title: Sessions disk free
panels.description: Free space a non-root writer can use on the disk of the session store; the dashed line is the 512 MiB of CoddyDiskLow.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU time per second of wall time: 1 is one core busy.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Open descriptors per process; each MCP server, background command and open session store file counts.
